json.description: List of cookie name patterns (regex strings) to delete when the user denies a category. Runs on aed:consent:change, aed:consent:ready, and on a 30s polling interval.

always.description: Patterns deleted unconditionally on every check (e.g. legacy cookies you no longer want).

categories.description: Map of consent category id → array of patterns deleted when that category is denied. Example: { analytics: ['^_ga', '^_gid'], marketing: ['^_fbp'] }.
